whyWisdom.title: MEMBER OWNERSHIP
whyWisdom.text: Wisdom is a cooperative. Members are the reason it exists and the people it serves.

whyWisdom.title: COMMUNITY
whyWisdom.text: Members grow together. The strength of the cooperative comes from its community.

whyWisdom.title: ACCESSIBILITY
whyWisdom.text: Cooperative finance exists to be within reach of ordinary members and their goals.

whyWisdom.title: TRANSPARENCY
whyWisdom.text: Wisdom operates under its governance and reporting structures, and keeps members informed.

whyWisdom.title: FINANCIAL EMPOWERMENT
whyWisdom.text: Through saving, credit and education, members build financial strength that lasts.

growthJourney.title: Save
growthJourney.text: Members build savings within the cooperative, one contribution at a time.

growthJourney.title: Build
growthJourney.text: Personal balances grow and the cooperative's shared strength builds with them.

growthJourney.title: Access
growthJourney.text: Members access credit under Wisdom's policies when they have a plan.

growthJourney.title: Grow
growthJourney.text: Repaid credit and consistent saving create durable financial growth.

growthJourney.title: Prosper
growthJourney.text: Members and their community become stronger together over time.
